In this video we cover:
1. India’s Paper Industry Crisis
India’s paper sector is under pressure—only 550 of 900 mills are active. Imports have doubled in 4 years, raw material costs are rising, and duty-free competition from ASEAN and China is hurting local manufacturers. The government may impose Quality Control Orders to regulate imports and protect domestic players.
